description: Optional push-to-deploy: link this project to a GitHub repository so a workflow in that repo can deploy on every push to one branch, with no API key stored in GitHub (it authenticates with GitHub OIDC). Returns `workflow`: write it to .github/workflows/novence.yml in the repo, set `dir` to the build output folder, add a build step if the site needs one, then commit and push. Novence does not clone or build the repo. Needs a verified email. Call again to change the repository or branch; with no repository argument it returns the current connection. Deploys from git count toward the plan's monthly deploys.

branch.description: Branch that deploys to the live site. Default "main". Other branches and pull requests never deploy.

project_id.description: Hosting project UUID from create_project or list_projects.

repository.description: GitHub repository as "owner/name" or a github.com URL. Omit to read the current connection.

name: connect_github_repo
title: Connect a GitHub repository
